parameters.query:
SELECT 
    al.id,
    al.tenant_id,
    al.campaign_id,
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT a.id FROM agents a WHERE a.tenant_id = al.tenant_id AND a.status = 'active' LIMIT 1),
        NULL
    ) AS agent_id,
    al.identifier AS cnpj,
    al.whatsapp AS phone,
    al.name,
    (al.metadata->>'loan_request_id')       AS loan_request_id,
    (al.metadata->>'requested_amount')      AS requested_amount,
    (al.metadata->>'fiserv_status')         AS current_fiserv_status,
    (al.metadata->>'fiserv_external_status') AS current_external_status
FROM agent_leads al
WHERE al.metadata->>'fiserv_status' IN (
    'in_progress','fail_to_contact','contact_updated',
    'comite','in_quoting','comite_approved','formalization'
  )
  AND al.metadata->>'loan_request_id' IS NOT NULL
  AND (al.metadata->>'fiserv_offer_sent') IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
  AND (al.metadata->>'fiserv_requested_at')::timestamptz > now() - interval '7 days'
LIMIT 100;

parameters.query:
UPDATE agent_leads
SET metadata = metadata
   || jsonb_build_object('fiserv_status', 
        CASE 
          WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' = 'approved' THEN 'comite_approved'
          ELSE '{{ $json.status }}'
        END
      )
   || jsonb_build_object('fiserv_external_status', '{{ ($json.external_status || "") }}'::text)
   || (CASE 
         WHEN '{{ $json.decided }}' = 'true' 
         THEN jsonb_build_object(
           'fiserv_offer_sent', 'true',
           'fiserv_offer_data', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.offer_data || {}) }}'::jsonb,
           'fiserv_amount_approved', '{{ $json.offer_data?.SomaPrincipal || $json.offer_data?.amount || "" }}',
           'max_installments', '{{ $json.offer_data?.installments || "" }}'
         )
         ELSE '{}'::jsonb 
       END)
WHERE metadata->>'loan_request_id' = '{{ $json.loan_request_id }}'
  AND tenant_id = '{{ $json._tenant_id }}'::uuid;

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    c.id                    AS conversation_id,
    c.status                AS conversation_status,
    a.id                    AS agent_id,
    a.evolution_instance,
    a.whatsapp_provider     AS provider,
    a.meta_api_token,
    a.meta_phone_number_id,
    a.zenvia_api_token,
    a.zenvia_channel_id
FROM conversations c
LEFT JOIN agents a 
    ON a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id 
   AND a.status = 'active'
WHERE c.user_identifier = '{{ $('Montar consulta').item.json._phone }}'
  AND c.tenant_id = '{{ $('Montar consulta').item.json._tenant_id }}'::uuid
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

    updated_at = now()
